exercise.bookAnswer:
(a) H₂SO₄
Atomic mass of H = 1  Atomic mass of S = 32  Atomic mass of O = 16
Add the contribution of each atom
2(1) + 1 (32) + 4(16) = 98 g mol⁻¹
(b) C₆H₁₂O₆
Atomic mass of C = 12  Atomic mass of H = 1  Atomic mass of O = 16
Add the contribution of each atom
6(12) + 12(1) + 6(16) = 180 g mol⁻¹
